sources.summary: The media library and music school are built against an ochre cliff, which gives them unique character. The aim here was to place a modern construction in one of Europe's most beautiful medieval towns, listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site and characterized by the golden hue of its maze of quaint alleyways with old townhouses.
